items.title: Construct the actual determinant-conditioned Gaussian mixtures

source.anchor: arXiv:2610.20492v1 Section3.1 single-block P_b definition before Eq6; Section2 determinant-conditioned Haar and AppendixB2.2 standing range.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. The source definition of the single-block mixture is made measure-theoretically explicit; omitted construction bookkeeping is supplied background, not attributed author proof.

items.statement:
Let \(n\ge3\), \(\kappa\ge4\), and let \(\mu\) be normalized Borel Haar probability on the full real orthogonal group. Set \(A_O= rac{\kappa+1}{2}I_n- rac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^	op)\), \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\), and \(
u_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\). The actual Gaussian family \(O\mapsto\gamma_O\) is measurable as a map into Borel measures on Euclidean \(\mathbb R^n\). Its actual mixtures \(P_\pm=\int\gamma_O\,d
u_\pm(O)\) are probability measures, and for every Borel set \(B\), \(P_\pm(B)=\int\gamma_O(B)\,d
u_\pm(O)\). All family measurability and probability-construction facts are conclusions. The source leaves these well-definedness details implicit; product targets, bounded-test expectation transport and the total-variation interpretation remain separate.
assumptions: Exactly \(n\ge3\) and \(\kappa\ge4\). No measurable-family, probability-kernel or normalization premise is supplied.
\(\mu\) is the same normalized Borel Haar probability on the full real orthogonal group. Both determinant signs occur.
\(\nu_\pm=2\mu|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\), and \(\gamma_O\) is the existing canonical Gaussian with zero mean and covariance \(A_O^{-1}\). The state space is Borel Euclidean \(\mathbb R^n\).

Measurability, positive-definiteness justification, prior probability, mixture probability and every Borel-set evaluation are produced internally. The source omits this construction bookkeeping; it is supplied explicitly here.

obligations.label: Actual measurable Gaussian family, probability mixtures and Borel-event evaluation

bindings.boundary: Actual single-block Gaussian family measurability, both determinant-conditioned probability measures and their universal Borel-set evaluations only, n>=3 and kappa>=4. Source omits measurable-family/bind well-definedness bookkeeping; this supplies it without inventing an author proof. No product Eq6, mixture-density/expectation interchange, H expectation gap, TV adapter, Poisson, parameters, transcript, eigenbasis or main lower bound.

assumption_deltas.source: Source single-block definition uses n>=3,kappa>=4, full Haar conditioned on each determinant sign, and N(0,A_O inverse); measurable-family and probability-construction bookkeeping is implicit.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exactly these source parameters and literal laws. Actual Gaussian measurability, both normalized-prior binds probability and all Borel evaluations are proved internally.
